resources.string: Lets AA Bridge one-click start Android Auto\'s \"head unit server\" developer mode instead of you doing it by hand (Settings → tap Version 10x → ⋮ → Start head unit server).
Start Android Auto on your phone
Open Android Auto, tap ⋮, then Start head unit server.
On your phone, open Android Auto, tap ⋮, Stop head unit server, then Start head unit server.
